name: Fruit Million

features.name: 100 paylines
features.description: A classic fruit layout with many lines.

features.name: Expanding wilds
features.description: Wilds on reels 2–4 expand to fill the reel.

review:
A proper classic: 100 lines of fruits, diamonds, bells and four-leaf clovers. The wild only lands on reels 2, 3 and 4, and when it does it fills the whole reel, hitting lots of lines at once.

Bells and diamonds are scatters, and there's a card gamble after wins if you fancy it. Medium-high volatility and a 3,000x max. The headline is the 97.34% RTP – one of the best we list. BGaming makes seasonal versions too, but this original is the one to try.
pros: Excellent 97.34% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
